Planning guide · Beta editorial draft

Tokyo

Build your visit around neighborhoods rather than a long checklist. Pick one main area for each half-day and leave time for meals and discoveries.

Choose your base

Compare the journeys you expect to make most often. Before booking, check the walk from the station, room size, luggage arrangements, and your arrival route.

A suggested first day

Keep arrival day light. Settle into your accommodation, explore nearby streets, and find an easy dinner. Save a tightly timed attraction for another day.

Make a neighborhood day

Consider an eastern Tokyo day around Asakusa and Ueno, or a western day around Shibuya and Harajuku. Check actual journeys and opening hours before committing.

Leave one day open

Use your flexible day for an interest that emerges during the trip, a weather change, or simply a slower morning.

Check before you go

Official destination information ↗. Confirm current opening hours, access, and transport directly. These suggested routes are editorial starting points, not verified live schedules.
